name: Archie and the Others Flee the Bunker
description: Archie runs down the narrow stairs of the bunker, his footsteps quick and urgent. Troy follows close behind, keeping pace without a word. Doc comes last, moving as fast as he can, the dim light casting sharp shadows on the walls as they descend.

description: Archie Gates comes across five Iraqi soldiers who are disoriented and visibly afraid, their hands raised in the air. He tells them not to panic and orders them to step outside. They comply, moving out of their position under his direction.

description: The group moves quickly through a large room lined with shelves of stereos and illuminated by glowing television screens. One wall holds a massive poster of Saddam. In the back, Archie grits his teeth, his body tensing as Doc pours disinfectant over the gunshot wound in his lower left arm. The liquid stings, and Archie lets out a sharp breath. Doc presses a clean cloth against the wound and begins wrapping it tightly with bandages while the vehicle bounces over uneven terrain.

description: Cathy Daitch stands beside a cameraman filming Captain Van Meter, while another man holds a boom microphone overhead. Van Meter leans on a surface, adjusting his stance. "How about if I lean on it, like this?" he asks. "Very dashing," Daitch replies. He tries a few different poses, then says, "Does it look too posed?" She responds, "Would you ever stand like that?" After testing a couple of positions, he says, "I think I might, Jesus, this feels stupid." "You'll get used to it," she says. She begins the interview by asking, "First question: did you dream as a boy you'd be commanding an infantry company in a desert war?" Van Meter answers, "As a boy, I wanted to be either a veterinarian or a CIA sharpshooter --"

description: The Hummer speeds into a village piazza with an old fortress at one end, heading straight for the entrance of an underground bunker. Archie Gates uses a megaphone to announce, 'United States Marine Corps. Put your weapons down.' Troy and Doc jump out, pistols extended, and confront two Iraqi soldiers who are holding rifles. 'Drop your weapon,' Troy demands. 'Put it down,' Doc repeats. They shove the soldiers face-first into the dirt, cuff their hands behind their backs, and take them into custody. Nearby, Vig glares at another Iraqi soldier named Abdul and growls, 'Don't make me smoke your ass, Abdul.'

name: Soldiers Open Fire on Approaching Tanker Truck
description: Four Iraqi soldiers armed with rifles run into the village square and begin shooting. A group of rock-throwing Shiites scatter. Two men fall to the ground, hit by gunfire. A child cries out. Vig stands alone, terrified, pointing his unloaded pistol. The soldiers turn toward him, raising their rifles, when two of them suddenly look to the side and shout. A shiny metal tanker truck is barreling toward the square from three hundred yards out. The soldiers swing their rifles toward the truck and open fire.

description: Captain Van Meter walks with an M-16 rifle, speaking to a CBS camera crew and demonstrating the weapon. As he explains its use in Vietnam, General Horn approaches and calls out to him. Van Meter acknowledges the general, who demands to know what he is doing. Van Meter replies that he is giving an interview. The general asks if he has authorization. Van Meter produces a folded paper and hands it to him. The general looks at the document and says no. Van Meter asks if he cannot proceed, and the general tells him to come along, stating he does not have permission to do the interview.

At the far end of the corridor, an Iraqi Soldier steps into view, sees the advancing men, and immediately turns to flee. Archie and Troy sprint past the retreating soldier without breaking stride. Doc tackles the Iraqi, slamming him face down to the ground, then cuffs him. Archie reaches a door, kicks it open, and rushes inside, with Troy right behind him.

description: Raging oil fires send thick black smoke into the air, obscuring the landscape. Walter rides a motorcycle through the smoke, gripping the handlebars as flames rise fifty feet on either side. Paco the Cameraman holds on behind him, camera in hand. Bill Smithson sits in the sidecar, coughing, his voice sharp with frustration. He shouts that the story is boring, that he’s already done it, and demands to know where the gold is. name: Archie Explains Bunker Assault and a Haunting Memory
description: Archie Gates stands with Troy, Doc, and Vig near a bomb crater, the three men in white anti-gas suits holding pistols and drinking from plastic water bottles. A skinny cow wanders nearby. Archie begins to speak about how they will approach the bunker, describing the method as fast and decisive—moving so quickly that the guards won’t have time to react. Troy kicks at the sand, and a decayed human arm emerges from the ground, attached to a body with a half-rotted face. He steps back, startled. Archie continues, saying they dropped many bombs and buried some men alive. Vig looks at him, confused. Archie explains that Bradleys equipped with large plows cut through the earth, pushing sand over trenches. He says the soldiers had the chance to surrender but chose to stay. As he speaks, the image forms of a massive plow advancing, sand rolling forward, covering five Iraqi soldiers wide-eyed with fear. Archie then tells the team to begin the rehearsal.

description: General Pye confronts Major Archie Gates for mishandling the media, demanding he stop Cathy as she runs off while dressing. Military police intercept her, grabbing her and stating she is in violation of code 37D for grinding Major Gates, then release her. Soldiers in gas suits laugh at the scene. Archie turns to General Horn, grabs the corner of his collar with one star, and demands to know what he was made a general for. General Horn replies that he was made a general, and Archie scoffs, listing how others have gained fame and power from the war. General Horn asks if Archie is high, calling the operation a huge win. Archie points out the irony of having the largest army in the world while Iraq still has its dictator. General Pye suggests Archie focus on helping Smithson to secure future movie consulting work. General Horn adds that otherwise, Archie might end up a security guard after retirement. Archie tells him to fuck off. name: Troy and Doc Confront Archie About the Shipping Plan
description: Small, round, Vuitton overnight bags lie open across the basement floor, each filled with five gold bars. Troy and Doc watch as Archie paces, sweating and restless. They press him for details about how the gold will be moved. Archie stops pacing and tells them he has a contact in the French Special Forces who will pack the gold into barrels filled with oil and bury them. In a few weeks, the barrels will be driven to Yanbu, a port in Saudi Arabia. From there, a friend will load the shipment onto a Turkish boat, which will carry it up the Red Sea to Perpignan. A French boat will then take it to Baltimore. Troy interrupts, asking where Yanbu is. After Archie answers, Troy points out the hat boxes won’t fit in the Humvee. Archie says they’ll need a trailer. description: The Humvee roars into the village central square with 'I Get Around' by The Beach Boys blaring from the speakers. A large American flag flaps from a pole at the back of the vehicle. Vig drives at high speed, swerving past Shiite civilians in black robes, skinny dogs, and bewildered Iraqi soldiers. Archie studies a map, first pointing right, then quickly correcting and pointing left. Vig jerks the wheel, sending the Humvee racing toward a low cement building guarded by two Iraqi soldiers. The soldiers freeze as the vehicle hurtles toward them, then screeches to a stop just short of impact. The flag continues to flutter in the wind as Vig stands up and raises a megaphone.
related_events: Humvee speeds into village central square with loud music playing
Vig drives Humvee erratically around town square
Humvee approaches low cement building with Iraqi soldiers

name: Archie Gates Corrects Bunker Location
description: Archie Gates studies a map as the Humvee speeds through the village square. He points to a decayed green building and says the bunker should be there. Vig turns the vehicle sharply right, then immediately jerks the wheel left when Archie corrects himself, directing him toward a low cement building ahead. Two Iraqi soldiers stand guard in front. The Humvee races toward them, skids to a stop, and the American flag flutters from the vehicle's rear.
related_events: Archie Gates identifies target bunker location using map

name: Securing the Bunker Entrance
description: Vig stands in the back of the Humvee, using a megaphone to declare, 'We are the Army of the United States of America. We are here to protect you. Remain calm.' As the American flag flutters behind them, Troy and Doc jump out with pistols drawn, hands raised in a 'halt' gesture. The two Iraqi guards freeze. Troy and Doc quickly move forward, take the guards' machine guns, and push them face down onto the ground. Troy pulls out plastic twist cuffs and secures one of the soldiers' hands behind his back. Archie steps forward holding a thick white document, pointing toward the bunker door, which Doc now holds open.
related_events: Vig uses megaphone to declare U.S. military presence
Troy and Doc disarm Iraqi guards and force them to the ground
Troy handcuffs one of the Iraqi soldiers with plastic twist cuffs

name: Archie Gates Asserts Authority with Presidential Orders
description: Archie Gates steps forward holding a thick white document, raising it in the air. He declares they have orders from President Bush. A gaunt Iraqi mother opens her blouse, showing her small breasts, and pleads for baby milk. Troy turns toward her, startled, but Archie pushes him aside, shoving him past the woman and toward the bunker door, where Doc stands holding it open. The mother remains in the square, still pleading, as Archie follows Troy and Doc into the building.
related_events: Archie Gates presents official document claiming authority from President Bush
Iraqi mother reveals empty breasts and pleads for baby milk
Archie pushes Troy past the distressed mother toward the bunker entrance

name: Approach the Bunker and Survive the Booby-Trapped Cow
description: The Humvee speeds toward the bunker with Archie, Troy, Doc, and Vig inside, pistols ready. As they near, a cow stands motionless outside the entrance. They stop short. Troy and Doc jump out, flanking the animal. The cow steps back—and explodes. Flesh and entrails splatter across Troy and Doc. The cow’s head lands on the hood of the Humvee with a heavy thud. Archie checks for injuries. Doc wipes gore from his face and says it’s all cow. Vig picks pieces off himself. Archie empties the shells from Vig’s pistol and pockets them. No one is hurt.
related_events: Humvee approaches bunker with armed soldiers preparing to engage
Cow explodes as soldiers exit Humvee
Soldiers check for injuries after cow explosion

name: Archie Disarms Vig and Explains Gunshot Wounds
description: After the cow explodes, splattering Troy and Doc with entrails, Archie asks if anyone is hurt. Doc confirms it’s all cow. He remarks that the area was supposed to be cleared of mines, but Archie replies that mines are forever and no one ever clears them all. Troy murmurs quietly, 'If you could, help me Rhonda, help help me Rhonda.' Archie watches him, then turns to the others. He asks if they’ve seen any real action. Vig jokes about only seeing night bombings on CNN, except for Troy shooting a man in the neck. Archie takes Vig’s large pistol, empties the shells, and pockets them. He asks if sepsis is cool. When Vig doesn’t know what it is, Doc explains it’s an infection of the blood. Archie compares it to a septic tank, describing how a bullet tears through tissue, creating a cavity of dead flesh that fills with bile and bacteria. For a moment, the image shifts: in slow motion, a bullet pierces muscle, the wound pulsing and filling with fluid. Back in the Humvee, Archie goes on to describe tension pneumothorax—a small hole in the lung that lets air leak into the chest cavity with each breath, slowly compressing the organs. He says the person is killed by their own breathing, one breath at a time. Doc interrupts, saying it’s not fatal if treated. Archie agrees—by making a small hole to release the air, like with a tire. The others look at him, silent and unsettled. Troy asks if they can play the Beach Boys when they go in. Doc mutters about the Beach Boys again. Troy insists he’s not ashamed—he finds their music calming, better than Mozart. Archie says Bach.
related_events: Archie disarms Vig and confiscates ammunition
Archie explains dangers of gunshot wounds and sepsis
Archie describes mechanism of tension pneumothorax from bullet or blade wound
Doc challenges Archie's claim about fatality of chest injury

name: Troy Murmurs to Rhonda and Requests the Beach Boys
description: After the cow explodes and the group stands splattered with entrails, Troy murmurs quietly, 'If you could, help me Rhonda, help help me Rhonda.' Later, he asks if they can play the Beach Boys when they go in. Doc scoffs, calling it the goddamn Beach Boys, but Troy says he’s not ashamed—he likes them because they calm him down, even more than Mozart. Archie responds with a single word: 'Bach.'
related_events: Troy murmurs plea to Rhonda during mission
Troy requests Beach Boys music during mission entry
Troy defends preference for Beach Boys over classical music
Archie corrects musical preference to Bach

name: Vig Stops Attack on Cuffed Prisoner
description: Vig keeps two cuffed Iraqi guards on the ground at gunpoint as fifteen Shiites armed with crude clubs and slingshots close in. One of the Shiites fires a rock from a slingshot, striking one of the handcuffed Iraqis in the back of the head. Vig raises his pistol and shouts for them to stop. The Shiites pull back as he waves his weapon. He demands to know what is happening. The camera shifts to ten Shiites and a naked man with glasses, who is being led out from the side of the bunker by an unarmed Iraqi sergeant and beginning to dress. Vig orders the sergeant to get on the ground. The sergeant responds in Arabic, saying the prisoner should stay. A Shiite woman runs up to the man with glasses and embraces him, crying. A little girl with dirty casts on both arms runs to him and hugs his legs. The bound Shiite prisoners start moving away from the bunker. The unarmed sergeant rushes after them, shoving them back. The free Shiites respond by throwing rocks and hitting him with clubs. Vig yells for everyone to calm down.
related_events: Shiite guard hits handcuffed Iraqi with slingshot
Vig orders Shiites to stop violence and retreat

name: Prisoner Escorted from Bunker Amid Tensions
description: The unarmed Iraqi sergeant leads the naked man with glasses out of the bunker. As they emerge, Vig levels his pistol and shouts for the prisoner to get on the ground. The sergeant stands his ground and speaks in Arabic, saying, 'Prisoner stay. Gabar matan.'
related_events: Unarmed Iraqi sergeant escorts naked prisoner from bunker
Vig demands the naked prisoner to get on the ground
Iraqi sergeant declares prisoner status in Arabic

name: Woman and Girl Embrace Freed Man with Glasses
description: The man with glasses steps out from the side of the bunker, still dressing, when a Shiite woman runs to him and throws her arms around him, sobbing. A little girl with dirty casts on both arms rushes forward and clings to his legs. The man stands between them, silent, as they hold him close.
related_events: Shiite woman embraces tortured man with glasses and sobs
Little girl with broken arms hugs man's legs

name: Prisoners Flee, Sergeant Confronts, Mob Attacks
description: The bound Shiite prisoners started moving away from the bunker. The unarmed Iraqi sergeant ran after them, shoving them back. Free Shiites responded by hurling rocks and swinging clubs at the sergeant, striking him as chaos erupted.
related_events: Bound Shiite prisoners begin to leave bunker area
Unarmed Iraqi sergeant chases and pushes back prisoners
Free Shiites attack sergeant with rocks and clubs

name: Vig Shouts for Calm Amid Chaos
description: Vig keeps the two cuffed Iraqi guards on the ground at gunpoint as fifteen Shiites armed with crude clubs and slingshots close in. One of the Shiites fires a rock from a slingshot, striking one of the handcuffed Iraqis in the back of the head. Vig raises his pistol and shouts, 'Don't start this shit again,' causing the Shiites to step back. He then demands, 'Hey, what the hell is going on here?' As ten Shiites and a naked man with glasses emerge from the side of the bunker, being led by an unarmed Iraqi sergeant, Vig orders, 'Git on the fucking ground, Arab.' The sergeant responds, 'Prisoner stay. Gabar matan.' A Shiite woman runs forward and embraces the man with glasses, sobbing, while a little girl with dirty casts on both arms hugs his legs. The bound Shiite prisoners begin to walk away from the bunker, prompting the sergeant to chase after them, shoving them back. Free Shiites retaliate by throwing rocks and striking him with clubs. Vig yells, 'Goddamn it everybody calm down.'
related_events: Vig orders everyone to calm down

name: Troy Witnesses Violence at the Compound
description: Troy runs out the front door of the building. Outside, two soldiers are beating Shiite individuals on the ground while five others stand nearby. A woman lies on the ground surrounded by the group. Troy looks toward them, his expression shifting. The Iraqi Major turns and fixes Troy with a cold, steady stare.
related_events: Troy runs out of the building through the front door
Two soldiers violently beat Shiite individuals
Iraqi Major confronts Troy with a cold stare

name: Troy Confirms the Item Is Secured
description: Vig turns to Troy, his voice urgent. 'Did you get it? Troy, did you get it?' Troy looks at him, then back at the scene around them. 'Yeah, we got it,' he says. Vig presses, 'Is it a lot?' Troy hesitates for a moment, then nods. 'Yeah, it's a lot.'
related_events: Vig urgently asks Troy if he obtained the item
Troy confirms acquisition of a significant amount

name: Troy and Vig Secure the Ox Cart
description: Troy and Vig wrestle an ox cart free from a tangled pile of wreckage near a bombed-out building. Troy retrieves a heavy chain from the Humvee and drags it across the ground. Together, they loop the chain around the ox cart and fasten it to the vehicle, securing it for transport.
related_events: Troy and Vig struggle to extract an ox cart from wreckage
Troy pulls a heavy chain from the Humvee
Troy and Vig chain the ox cart to the Humvee

name: Troy Recites Car Lyrics Amid Chaos
description: Troy pulls a heavy chain from the Humvee, then helps untangle an ox cart from a pile of wreckage near a bombed-out building. As he works, he quietly recites lyrics about a 'little deuce coupe' with a fiat head mill, saying it can do a hundred and forty with the top end floored. He repeats the line 'She's my little deuce coupe' under his breath. Around him, soldiers beat Shiites, a man is struck in the face with a club, and a young girl with arm casts screams as her father tries to hold her.
related_events: Troy quietly recites lyrics under his breath
Troy recites lyrics about his vehicle's speed and model

name: A Man Struck, a Girl Screams
description: A Shiite man falls to the ground after being hit in the face with a club. Nearby, a little girl with arm casts cries out, struggling in the arms of her father, a man in glasses, as he tries to hold her still.
related_events: A Shiite man is struck in the face with a club
The Little Girl with arm casts screams while her father tries to hold her

name: Archie Stops the Electrocution and Disarms the Sergeant
description: A bound, naked Shiite man in glasses sits in a shallow metal box filled with water, an electric cable submerged beside him. He trembles as the current passes through the water. Archie strides forward and yanks the cable out. The Iraqi Sergeant approaches, saying, 'I am just do my job, buddy.' Archie turns, delivers a backhand that sends the Sergeant flying across the room, then steps on his wrist and takes the pistol from his hand. The man in the box remains still, breathing heavily, as Archie stands over the disarmed soldier.
related_events: Archie yanks electric cable from water-filled metal box
Iraqi Sergeant claims he is just doing his job
Archie backhands Iraqi Sergeant across the room
Archie steps on Sergeant's wrist and disarms him

name: Archie Confronts the Interrogator Over Abandoned Captives
description: Archie saw ten bound and gagged Shiites across the room—three men, women, and four children. He moved toward them, but the Interrogator, a captain, stepped into his path. The Interrogator said, 'These Shiite. Iraq problem. United States is out now.' He added, 'We take them outside, so it don't bother you, OK, sir? Kata fanam.' The Iraqi Sergeant nodded, opened a small rear door, and pushed the group out into the dark. Archie turned back, his face unreadable.
related_events: Archie sees bound Shiites including men, women, and children in the room
Interrogator blocks Archie's path and justifies abandoning Shiites
Interrogator promises to remove Shiites from the room
Iraqi Sergeant opens rear door and forces Shiites outside

name: Archie Demands Access to the Basement
description: After the Interrogator stepped in front of Archie and said the Shiites were an Iraqi problem, Archie watched as the Sergeant opened a small rear door and pushed the bound group outside. The Interrogator spoke again, suggesting they take the prisoners away to avoid disturbing Archie. Archie turned, walked back into the main room, and pointed his pistol directly at the Captain's face. 'Take us to the basement,' he said.
related_events: Archie points pistol at Interrogator's face and demands access to basement

name: Troy Witnesses the Interrogation and Confrontation
description: Troy stands silently in the room as a bound, naked Shiite man in glasses shivers in a shallow metal box filled with water, an electric cable submerged beside him. Archie strides forward and yanks the cable out. The Iraqi Sergeant says, 'I am just do my job, buddy.' Archie responds with a backhand that sends the man flying into the corner. He steps on the Sergeant's wrist and takes the pistol from his hand. Across the room, ten Shiites—three men, women, and four children—are bound and gagged, their faces tense with fear. Archie moves toward them, but the Interrogator, a captain, blocks his path. 'These Shiite. Iraq problem. United States is out now,' the captain says. He adds, 'We take them outside, so it don't bother you, OK, sir? Kata fanam.' The disarmed Sergeant nods, gets up, and opens a small rear door, pushing the group out. Archie turns, walks back, and points his pistol at the captain's face. 'Take us to the basement,' Archie says, his voice cold and steady.
related_events: Troy silently observes abuse and confrontation

name: Confrontation Over the Suitcases
description: The Iraqi Captain, pacing and shouting, suddenly lunges at Doc, tackling him to the ground and choking him. Troy reacts immediately, punching the Captain in the head and pulling him off. Archie steps forward, pressing his pistol to the Captain’s face. “Listen to me,” Archie says. “We leave you alone to kill your Shiites, but everything you took from Kuwait, that belongs to us now, understand?” He turns to Doc. “Put it back.” Doc hesitates. “Why?” Archie repeats the order. Reluctantly, Doc and Troy empty the jewelry they had taken into their pockets. Troy then cuffs the Captain’s hands behind his back. The Captain begins to cry as the three men continue opening the suitcases, revealing brick after brick of gold.
related_events: Iraqi Captain attacks Doc during suitcase inspection
Troy punches the Iraqi Captain to protect Doc
Archie threatens the Iraqi Captain at gunpoint

name: Inspecting the Suitcases and Discovering the Gold
description: Archie, Doc, and Troy unzipped the large Louis Vuitton suitcases one by one. The first contained antique silverware, the next was filled with jewelry. Archie opened another to reveal hundreds of gold Cartier watches. Doc and Troy slipped some of the jewelry into their pockets, but Archie ordered them to put it back, insisting they stick to the plan. They moved on to the next suitcase, which held a stack of Kuwaiti passports. Then Doc opened a suitcase and froze. Inside were tightly packed five-kilo bricks of gold. Archie and Troy examined the bricks, confirming each weighed five kilos. They counted sixty bricks in one suitcase. Archie opened another—also filled with gold. So was the next, and the next. They checked all ten suitcases, each containing sixty gold bricks. The Iraqi Captain, handcuffed and pacing, began to cry. Archie calculated the total: thirty million dollars. The three men stared at one another in stunned silence. They tried lifting one of the suitcases sideways, but the fabric tore under the weight, spilling gold bars onto the floor. One landed on Troy’s foot, making him jump back in pain. Another suitcase split open the same way when they tried to move it. Doc explained the suitcases weren’t built to carry that much weight.
related_events: Archie, Troy, and Doc examine the contents of the Louis Vuitton suitcases
Group discovers multiple suitcases filled with gold bricks

name: Moving the Gold and Questioning the Luggage
description: Doc and Troy help Archie lift one of the oversized Louis Vuitton suitcases sideways, struggling under its weight. As they carry it, the suitcase tears open and gold bars spill onto the floor—one landing on Troy's foot, making him jump in pain. They try again with a second suitcase, hoisting it the same way, but it also rips apart and the bricks crash down. Doc says the suitcases can't handle the weight, explaining that each bar weighs about 13 pounds and the smaller bags are only rated for 65 pounds. Archie points out the suitcases weren't made to carry this much and asks the Interrogator if there's any other luggage in the room.
related_events: Doc and Troy assist Archie in lifting oversized suitcase
Suitcase ruptures and gold bars spill onto floor
Archie, Troy, and Doc lift second suitcase causing another rupture
Doc explains tensile strength of suitcases
Archie asks Interrogator about additional luggage

name: Troy and Doc Argue Over a Lexus Convertible While Moving Gold
description: Archie, Doc, and Troy struggle to carry a heavy, jumbo-sized suitcase full of gold bars, lifting it sideways like a tabletop. As they strain under the weight, Troy says he’s going to buy a fleet of Lexus convertibles in different colors. Doc tells him Lexus doesn’t make convertibles. Troy insists they do and bets Doc a Lexus. Doc agrees to the bet, saying it won’t be a convertible. Mid-argument, the suitcase rips open and gold bars spill onto the floor, one crushing Troy’s foot. He jumps back in pain. They hoist another suitcase the same way, and it too tears apart, spilling more gold.
related_events: Troy and Doc debate existence of Lexus convertible

name: Rocket Attack and Gas Cloud
description: Doc scans the sky through binoculars as a rocket cuts a jagged trail of smoke across the air. It explodes high above the Humvee, bursting into a thick brown cloud. "Gas," Doc shouts. Archie and Doc fumble with their gas masks, struggling to put them on. Vig reaches behind his seat, searching for his mask while still driving. The Humvee swerves off the road into the open desert as the brown cloud looms overhead.
related_events: Doc observes sky with binoculars in slow motion
Rocket streaks across sky leaving smoke trail
Rocket explodes in sky above Humvee
Brown gas cloud forms from explosion
Doc alerts others about gas
Archie and Doc struggle to put on gas masks

name: Vig Loses Control of Humvee While Reaching for Gas Mask
description: As the Humvee speeds down the road, Vig turns it off the pavement. Archie grabs the steering wheel and jerks it back, shouting for Vig to stay on the road. Above, a rocket explodes in the sky, releasing a brown gas cloud. Inside the vehicle, Doc and Archie struggle to put on their gas masks. Vig reaches behind him, searching for his mask while still driving. The Humvee swerves off the road and into the open desert.
related_events: Vig turns speeding Humvee off the road
Archie jerks steering wheel to keep Humvee on road
Archie warns Vig to stay on the road
Vig reaches for gas mask while driving
Vig loses control and veers into desert

name: Archie Spots Minefield and Evacuates Humvee Before Explosion
description: Archie sees a minefield ahead as the Humvee speeds across the desert. He shouts a warning and leaps from the vehicle. The others follow—Vig, Doc, the man holding the little girl, and the remaining Shiites, including the two young children. They scramble clear just as the Humvee hits a mine. The explosion lifts the vehicle into the air, tearing it apart in a burst of fire and smoke.
related_events: Archie discovers minefield ahead of Humvee
Archie and others evacuate Humvee to avoid mine explosion
Humvee strikes mine and explodes in midair

name: Troy Observes the Gas Cloud
description: Troy leans out the window of the moving truck, squinting up at the brown gas cloud spreading in the sky above the desert.
related_events: Troy leans out truck window to observe gas cloud

name: Passengers React to Incoming Rocket
description: The Humvee speeds down the road as a rocket streaks across the sky, trailing a squiggly white line of smoke. In slow motion, the Shiite passengers react in different ways—half of them hunch down, bracing for impact, while the others crane their necks upward, staring into the sky. Above the vehicle, the rocket explodes in a burst of smoke, forming a brown cloud. The passengers cower as the blast echoes overhead.
related_events: Shiite passengers react to incoming rocket

name: Troy Paraded in Drunken Patriotic Frenzy
description: Troy is hoisted onto the shoulders of soldiers as 'Proud To Be An American' blares. He sings at the top of his voice, holding a Coke can in one hand and a Bud can in the other like raised torches. Around him, soldiers scream and lose control, spraying beer from their mouths. The room surges with noise and motion, bodies jostling, voices roaring in unison as the celebration spirals into chaos.
related_events: Troy is paraded on soldiers' shoulders during a patriotic celebration
Troy sings 'Proud To Be An American' at the top of his lungs
Soldiers erupt in frenzied celebration and spray beer

name: Walter Wogoman DJing Public Enemy Amid Bruce Lee Posters and Karate Moves
description: Walter Wogoman stood between two boom boxes, playing Public Enemy's 'I Can't Do Nothing For Ya Man' at full volume. A soldier peeled down one Bruce Lee poster after another, flipping them rapidly like an animation. Nearby, Vig, his nose wrapped in a bandage, thrust his arms in sharp, cheerleader-style karate motions. The music pounded through the room as the soldiers moved in chaotic rhythm, their energy surging with each beat.
related_events: Walter Wogoman operates two parallel boom boxes like a DJ to play Public Enemy's 'I Can't Do Nothing For Ya Man'
Soldier rapidly peels down Bruce Lee posters like a flip-book animation
Vig performs cheerleader-like karate arm movements while wearing a nose bandage

name: Soldiers Throw Toy Footballs at Troy in Chaotic Celebration
description: The soldiers hurled brightly painted toy footballs at Troy, who whipped them back with force. In the frenzy, someone tackled him over a table, and he crashed to the ground as the music pounded and the room erupted in screams.
related_events: Soldiers throw brightly painted toy footballs at Troy who whips them back
Troy is tackled over a table and crashes to the ground

name: Troy and Vig Exchange Screams Amid Soldier Chaos
description: After being tackled to the floor, Troy lets out a loud, raw scream. Vig crouches close, screaming directly into his face. Other soldiers surround them, shouting with intense, animal-like force. The room fills with the sound of overlapping screams as the chaos builds around Troy on the ground.
related_events: Troy and Vig exchange primal screams face-to-face
Soldiers scream viscerally at Troy on the floor imitating fierce animals

name: Captain Van Meter Shuts Down the Party
description: Amid a raucous celebration fueled by beer and blaring music, Captain Van Meter storms into the scene, shouting over the noise. He demands to know where the beer came from, his voice cutting through the chaos. The soldiers freeze as he barks that they have to take more Iraqis prisoner the next day, the weight of his words snapping the room back to the reality of their mission.
related_events: Captain Van Meter angrily demands to know the source of the beer

name: Surrender in the Desert
description: Hundreds of Iraqis walk across the desert with their hands raised. Captain Van Meter uses a megaphone to order them to lay down their weapons and get on the ground. Two Iraqis with severe facial wounds are given medical attention. Five others kneel, speaking in Arabic, pleading for mercy as they strip off their clothes. They reach for Troy Barlow, grabbing and kissing his hand while he keeps his rifle steady. Troy tells them they won’t be hurt. The group remains on the ground as U.S. forces maintain control.
related_events: Iraqi civilians surrender in the desert with hands raised
Captain Van Meter instructs surrendering Iraqis to lay down weapons
Five Iraqis disrobe and plead for mercy
Iraqis kiss Troy Barlow's hand in gratitude or fear
Two wounded Iraqis receive medical assistance

name: Troy and Vig Subdue the Defiant Iraqi Officer
description: An older Iraqi officer stood motionless while the others disrobed. Vig stepped forward, pointing his large pistol at the man's face. Troy intervened, speaking calmly and asking the officer to comply. When the officer did not respond, Troy punched him once in the head. Vig and Walter then grabbed the officer, forcing his pants down. The man resisted, shouting in protest, but was held in place as they stripped him. The officer remained silent, his body tense, as the soldiers completed the act.
related_events: Vig threatens surrendering Iraqis with a pistol
Troy Barlow intervenes to calm the situation
Troy Barlow punches the Iraqi officer after refusal to disrobe
Vig and Walter forcibly remove the Iraqi officer's pants

name: Extraction of a Concealed Map
description: Vig noticed a rolled-up piece of paper tucked into the Iraqi officer's rectum. As the officer protested, Walter and Vig restrained him while Vig put on a latex glove. He slowly pulled the greasy paper out. Troy instructed him to open it. Vig used a U.S. Army pen to unroll the document and lay it flat on the sand, revealing a handwritten map with sparse Arabic writing, roads, numbers, and three small boxes.
related_events: Vig discovers a rolled-up paper hidden in the Iraqi officer's rectum
Vig extracts the greasy rolled-up paper using a latex glove
Walter forcibly subdues the Iraqi officer during evidence retrieval
Vig uses an Army pen to unroll and flatten the greasy paper on the sand
Troy Barlow instructs Vig to open the retrieved document

name: Unfolding the Map from the Officer's Ass
description: Vig, wearing a latex glove, pulls a rolled-up, greasy piece of paper from the Iraqi officer's buttocks. The officer protests as Walter holds him down. Troy watches, disgusted, and tells Vig to open it. Using a U.S. Army pen, Vig carefully unrolls the paper and lays it flat on the sand. The paper reveals a handwritten map in Arabic, with a few roads, numbers, and three small boxes marked on it. Troy and Vig look at it closely, saying nothing at first. Troy finally remarks that something hidden that way must be important.
related_events: The hidden document is revealed to be a handwritten map with Arabic annotations

name: Troy Takes Aspirin After Confrontation
description: After the confrontation, Troy Barlow takes out a bottle of aspirin and swallows two pills. Vig looks at the Iraqi officer’s bare buttocks where the paper was hidden and says it’s a freaky thing, his voice tinged with unease.
related_events: Troy Barlow takes aspirin after the confrontation
Vig comments on the surreal nature of the situation

name: Forcing Entry Through the Locked Door
description: Troy fires his pistol at the door's lock, then steps back and charges it with his shoulder. He stumbles back, clutching his shoulder in pain as the door remains shut. Archie begins kicking the door hard, strike after strike. Troy joins him, and together they kick until the door suddenly bursts open.
related_events: Troy attempts to breach door by shooting the lock
Troy fails to break down door with shoulder charge
Archie and Troy jointly kick door until it opens

name: Troy Embraced by Iraqi Soldier
description: Troy enters the room and shouts 'Freeze!' but is immediately grabbed in a bear hug by a friendly Iraqi soldier who declares his love for the United States and hatred for Saddam. Troy jerks his elbows and attempts to break free with stiff, awkward movements resembling karate, but cannot loosen the man's grip. Doc steps forward, aims his pistol at the Iraqi's face, and orders him to let go. The Iraqi releases Troy and quickly raises his hands in the air, palms out. 'No problem, my friend,' he says.
related_events: Troy commands enemy to freeze upon entering room
Friendly Iraqi soldier embraces Troy in greeting
Troy attempts to escape bear hug with karate moves
Doc threatens Iraqi with pistol to release Troy
Iraqi soldier raises hands in surrender after release

name: Opening Crates in Search of Gold
description: Doc cuffs an Iraqi man's hands behind his back. Archie and Doc approach a series of wooden crates and open the first one, finding it filled with hundreds of Kuwaiti passports. Archie takes a bolt cutter and a pneumatic saw from his backpack, and the team uses the tools to open a second crate. Inside, they find more passports and no gold.
related_events: Doc restrains Iraqi prisoner by cuffing his hands
Archie and Doc open first crate filled with Kuwaiti passports
Archie retrieves bolt cutter and pneumatic saw from backpack
Archie and team use power tools to open second crate containing passports

name: Forcing the Iraqi to Reveal the Bunker
description: After opening two crates filled with Kuwaiti passports, the team finds no gold. Troy tells the Iraqi they are looking for gold, not chemical weapons. Archie pulls out an infrared map and shows it to the Iraqi, who says nothing. Doc and Troy raise their pistols and point them at the Iraqi in a show of force. With the guns aimed, Archie holds out the map and demands an answer. The Iraqi then points to a location on the map and says he will take them to the bunker.
related_events: Troy states mission objective is to find gold
Archie displays infrared map to Friendly Iraqi soldier
Doc and Troy threaten Friendly Iraqi soldier with guns
Friendly Iraqi soldier points to map and reveals bunker location

name: Troy Barlow Confronts Iraqi Soldier on Sand Berm
description: Troy Barlow runs across the desert toward a distant sand berm. He suddenly stops when he sees an Iraqi soldier standing on the crest. The Iraqi waves a white flag, then lowers it and picks up a rifle. Troy, breathing heavily, turns to his fellow soldiers. He asks if they are supposed to shoot. One of the soldiers responds by asking him the same question. Another soldier unwraps a piece of gum and shares it with others nearby. Further away, one soldier examines another’s eye, complaining about a grain of sand. In the distance, Captain Van Meter calls out: if the enemy surrenders, do not shoot; if they do not surrender, shoot. Troy turns back toward the berm, takes a few steps forward, then raises his rifle and aims through the scope. He pulls the trigger. The Iraqi soldier stands for a moment, then his neck erupts in a burst of blood. Troy lowers his rifle and walks toward the body, his footsteps and breathing the only sounds.
related_events: Troy Barlow halts upon seeing an Iraqi soldier on a sand berm

name: Explaining the Civil War and Shiite Persecution
description: Doc steps out of the stopped Humvee, shaken, and reassures the others he's fine before lying on the ground, breathing heavily with a hand on his chest. Archie paces, agitated, muttering about the art of war and how it should be used selectively, then angrily strips off his gas suit, revealing a sweat-soaked green T-shirt and boxers. Troy and Vig drink water quickly, drenched in sweat, and soon follow suit, removing their gas suits. Archie tosses each of them a U.S. Marine uniform without name tags. Troy refuses to put his on, arguing he has a family and doesn’t want to risk his life after the war is supposedly over. Archie asks the group what the most important thing in life is. Vig says respect, Doc says money, but Archie dismisses both, insisting it’s necessity that drives actions. He explains that necessity led the U.S. to avoid taking out Saddam, which in turn gave Saddam the necessity to target the Shiites to maintain power. Troy recalls the chaos they just witnessed—civilians spitting on their own soldiers, soldiers shooting civilians, and ignoring the team. Doc adds that the locals had already surrendered to them. Vig asks what a Shiite is. Archie responds that Shiites are the ethnic majority but have no power, and after the U.S. pulled out, they were told to rise up against Saddam and are now being slaughtered. Vig looks confused and asks how it could be the civil war. Troy clarifies that a civil war is a war within the same country. Archie checks his watch and suggests they have time to hit another bunker. Doc agrees, Vig says “rock and roll,” and Troy reluctantly agrees too, pulling a Kevlar vest from the Humvee and putting it on.

name: Doc Elgin Treats Vig's Hand and Provides Medication to Troy
description: Doc Elgin poured rubbing alcohol over Vig's extended hand, the liquid dripping off as Vig stood still under the antiseptic sting. Troy watched and remarked that Vig had washed his hands countless times already. Doc opened a case filled with pill bottles and asked what he could do for Troy’s headache. Troy asked for Vicodin, but Doc said it was gone. He offered Caffergot instead. Troy accepted, popped the pills, and swallowed them dry. Doc then turned his attention back to the map spread on the table, the medical kit still open at his side.

name: Doc Elgin Reveals Map and Bunker Intel
description: Doc Elgin pulls a document from a folder and unfolds it on the table, then spreads out a large aerial-photo map of the Iraqi desert beside the rumpled 'ass map.' He points to a location near Karbala and says it's where Saddam's bunkers are. Troy asks what's inside, and Doc Elgin replies that intelligence reports the bunkers are filled with looted luxury goods—Picasso paintings, Armani clothes, Rolexes, Mercedes, and Sony electronics—taken from Kuwait. Vig imagines buying a split-level house outside Jackson with a single gold Rolex, while Troy dreams of a silver Lexus convertible, arguing with Doc over whether Lexus makes a convertible model.

name: Troy, Vig, and Doc Imagine Life After the War
description: After Doc Elgin reveals that Saddam's bunkers near Karbala are filled with luxury goods looted from Kuwait—Picasso paintings, Armani clothing, Rolexes, Mercedes, and Sony electronics—Troy, Vig, and Doc begin talking about what they would do with the loot. Troy says he wants a silver Lexus convertible. Doc tells him Lexus doesn’t make a convertible, but Troy insists they do. Doc corrects him, saying Infiniti has one coming, but Troy doesn’t back down. Doc points out that even if such a car existed, there’s no way to get it home from Iraq. Troy replies that if he gets enough Rolexes, he could sell them and buy the car once he’s back in the States. Vig says one gold Rolex would be enough for him to buy a nice split-level house outside Jackson. Earlier, he had mentioned wanting a stereo system with ten BOS speakers.

name: Troy Questions Bunker Mission Risk, Doc Claims Divine Protection
description: Troy studies the aerial map of the Iraqi desert spread out beside the rumpled ass map, then voices concern about the danger of searching for the bunker, warning that a land mine could be in their path. Doc Elgin counters that they’re safe with him, dismissing the threat. Troy mocks the idea, asking if Doc has a galactic plutonium forcefield. Doc replies that he doesn’t talk about it, but he does have a ring of Jesus fire. Troy repeats the claim with skepticism. Vig interjects, saying he was baptized in water. Doc confirms he was fire baptized. Troy admits he doesn’t understand what water baptism means. Doc responds that for those who understand, no explanation is needed; for those who don’t, no explanation will suffice. He adds that Troy can benefit from his Jesus ring if he does right by him. Troy agrees. Earlier, when Troy questioned the mission’s risk, Doc explained that he had signed up for computer training but ended up deployed to the desert, waiting for Scud attacks without clear purpose—until the map appeared, which he now sees as a sign.

name: Archie Gates Takes Control of the Map
description: Archie Gates approaches the tent where Walter stands guard and confronts him at the entrance, pushing past to gain access. Inside, Troy and Doc quickly hide the maps under the table. Archie mocks Troy, Doc, and Vig, calling them nicknames, then demands to know the purpose of the tent. He identifies himself as a Special Forces officer. He retrieves the map from under the table, sniffs his fingers after handling it, and examines it closely. Troy insists that the map belongs to Captain Van Meter and that he will be the one to deliver it. Archie dismisses its value at first, but then pours rubbing alcohol over the surface and shines a special flashlight on it, revealing hidden infrared markings that show updated bunker locations near Karbala. He tells the group the bunkers may contain gold. Archie proposes they launch a mission together at dawn to investigate. When hesitation follows, he warns he will go alone if he has to, making it clear the mission will proceed with or without their cooperation.

description: Walter stands outside the tent wearing night vision goggles, moving through a series of blocking maneuvers. Troy tells him to take the goggles off, reminding him they don’t work during the day and to stay outside. Walter remains by the entrance, practicing verbal commands, shouting 'freeze' and 'do not pass' as he simulates stopping someone from entering. He repeats the actions, maintaining his position and carrying out the security routine.

name: Archie Gates Reveals Gold Bullion Plan and Takes Command
description: Archie Gates gathers the group and shifts their focus from looting Rolexes to a more ambitious target: Kuwaiti gold bullion. He describes kilo-sized gold bricks, each worth $50,000, stored in Saddam’s bunkers near Karbala. He argues that seizing just one bunker could change their lives forever. At the mention of the gold, each man drifts into silent reverie—Troy pictures himself in a sharp suit walking through Los Angeles, then flashes to a humbler image of repairing a photocopier in a drab office. Doc envisions himself as a red cap hauling luggage at Kennedy Airport. Vig imagines stalking through the woods of Mississippi, shooting stuffed animals with a rifle. Breaking the silence, Archie asserts his authority, declaring himself in command. He demands the others salute him. When they hesitate, he fixes them with a hard stare and insists. He then assigns Walter a separate mission—to act as a decoy and lead others away from their real objective. Turning to Vig, Archie issues a quiet but firm threat: if Vig speaks of the plan to anyone, he will kill him.

name: Archie Gates Recounts Past Missions to Justify Bunker Operation
description: Archie Gates stands with the group and describes his past operations, including stealing Noriega's boats in Panama and taking a gold Buddha in Vietnam. He points out that Iraqi forces have been thoroughly defeated, many of them demoralized and surrendering without a fight. When asked about the presence of enemy soldiers near the bunker, he waves off the concern, saying they are not a threat. The group listens as he lays out the context for the mission, grounding his confidence in his own experience and the current state of the Iraqi military.

description: The group began loading their luggage onto a cart, but the cart collapsed under the weight, scattering the bags across the ground. The Iraqi Major suggested they take the truck instead. Troy moved to the truck and began loading the luggage into the back, securing it as the vehicle filled up. Meanwhile, Archie climbed into the Humvee, started the engine, and sat waiting. Iraqi 6 approached the Humvee and tapped on the door in farewell. Archie nodded in response.

description: Iraqi soldiers pulled a woman from a group of captives, stood her in an open area, and shot her dead. She had been raped. The Americans watched in silence. Troy flinched in his seat and turned away. Doc stared without moving. Archie bowed his head against the steering wheel, resting there for a moment before lifting it again.

name: Archie Intervenes in Attack on Man Protecting Injured Girl
description: An Iraqi soldier grabs a girl in arm casts by the hair and pulls her away, but the Man in Glasses intervenes, punching the soldier and taking the girl. The soldier chases them with a knife and begins slashing at the man, cutting him. Archie approaches the group and demands the violence stop, but the soldier continues his attack. The Iraqi Major tells Archie to leave, and when Archie insists, he calls for backup. Troy and Doc exit their vehicles, draw their pistols, and aim them at two Iraqi soldiers who have moved forward, one of whom holds a rifle.

name: Archie Offers Gold for Captives' Freedom
description: Archie steps out of the Humvee and approaches the Iraqi soldiers. He offers a large amount of gold in exchange for the release of the Shiite captives. The Iraqi Major smiles, and the Interrogator laughs. They both refuse, saying they cannot let the Shiites go because Saddam will kill them if they do. The Iraqi Major repeats the order for Archie and his team to leave. Archie remains standing, then tells Troy and Doc to cover him.

name: Archie Intervenes to Stop an Attack and Sparks a Firefight
description: Archie strides toward the Iraqi soldiers as the one with the knife continues slashing at the Man in Glasses. He grabs the soldier and pulls him away, disarming him and shoving him to the ground. Archie helps the injured man to his feet, guiding him and the girl toward the Humvee. As he does, the Iraqi Major swings the barrel of a machine gun into Archie’s side. Archie grabs the weapon, and during the struggle, it fires, striking the Major in the leg. Before Archie can react, Iraqi 6 raises his rifle and shoots him in the lower left arm. Troy immediately opens fire, killing Iraqi 6. He keeps his rifle trained on the remaining Iraqis. Vig climbs into the Humvee, takes position at the mounted machine gun, and aims it at the Iraqi soldiers, holding his fire but ready. The American and Iraqi forces face off in a tense standoff. Iraqi guards shout and kick the Shiite prisoners back to the ground.

name: Survive the Iraqi Ambush and Take Control
description: Iraqi 7 opened fire on the Americans. The bullet struck Troy in the chest, but his Kevlar stopped it. As the windshield of the Humvee shattered, Doc turned and fired his pistol, hitting Iraqi 7 in the knee and killing him. Vig activated the mounted machine gun, firing tracer rounds that cut down two Iraqi soldiers in the rear. Archie drew his weapon and shot the Iraqi Major in the head at point-blank range. The remaining Iraqis dropped their weapons and raised their hands. The gunfire ceased, and the Americans stood in control of the scene.

name: Surrender and Escape Under Fire
description: After the gunfire ends, the remaining Iraqi soldiers raise their hands and drop their weapons. Big Iraqi 2 steps forward, bows before the Humvee, and kneels in surrender. Archie orders Doc to disarm the soldiers, then directs Vig to keep them covered. He commands that the Shiites be loaded into the Humvee, despite the tight space. Troy objects, questioning the need to take them, but Doc urges him to consider their situation. When Troy resists, he lifts his shirt to show his damaged Kevlar vest, torn from a recent impact. Archie stands firm, stating the rules have changed. As the group prepares to move, a tank and a rocket launcher truck approach in the distance. Vig grabs the grenade launcher, ready to fire, but Archie signals to disengage. He orders a retreat. Troy climbs into the truck, starts the engine, and the luggage-filled vehicle rumbles to life. Vig starts the Humvee, and Archie gets in beside him. The vehicles pull away quickly, carrying the rescued civilians with them.

name: Escape Amid Tank Malfunction and Rocket Launcher Arrival
description: The rescued Shiites, the Man in Glasses, and the Little Girl climb into the Humvee, squeezing into the available space. Doc gets in and takes his place inside. The Humvee pulls away from the scene just as an enemy tank rolls into view. The tank's turret begins to turn but suddenly jams, unable to rotate. An Iraqi soldier emerges from the hatch and calls out to report the malfunction. Another soldier climbs onto the turret and tries to turn it by hand. At the same time, a truck arrives carrying a small rocket launcher. The Americans do not stop; the Humvee accelerates, putting distance between itself and the site.
